![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUJOIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--573fdf538a21acdaa5aaf068feb5551af8f5c1df/Logo_big.png)
- [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) presents a PBQ of epic proportions!
- This competition will be testing the new revolutionary score-taking technology, **TimeBase!** We will be using traditional scorecards but will be offering a brand-new, paperless scoretaking experience for all registered competitors!
-  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.

items.name: Fleur-de-Lis Fall LA 2023
items.information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

Make sure to check out [Louisiana Speedcubing's Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1025679060833637) for upcoming competitions and announcements!

To learn more about Cubing in the US South, including other competitions, visit www.southerncubing.com.

- Please review the [competitor information] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FleurdeLisFall2023#29207-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FleurdeLisFall2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule
